caption: The drawing features five simplified, faceless figures resembling mannequins or dolls, each with peach-toned heads and bodies. The figures are arranged side by side in a single row. The first figure on the left is wearing long, vertical, beige pants and a light top, with both arms extended outward. The second figure wears a loose, off-the-shoulder light dress that reaches just above its knees. The third figure is dressed in a long, light-colored gown with a bow at the waist, and the fourth figure also wears a full-length light gown with draped detailing and a bow at the waist. The fifth and last figure wears a long, pale dress with a textured, crosshatched, darker shawl or wrap over the shoulders and a sash tied at the waist. All garments are depicted in shades of cream, white, and light gray, with subtle lines and shading to indicate folds and volume. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and there are no additional elements or decorations present in the composition.
title: Dolls
